spec.description: Detailed monitoring of Spark job execution, data movement, and resource utilization.

spec.title: Spark vs Wall Clock Execution Time
spec.description: Comparison between total real-world time (Wall Clock) and the time spent inside Spark operations. The gap represents driver overhead.

spec.title: I/O Throughput: Bytes Read/Written
spec.description: Total volume of data processed by executors, highlighting the external storage impact.

spec.title: Shuffle Intensity: Internal Data Exchange
spec.description: Bytes read and written during shuffle phases, indicating the degree of data redistribution across the cluster.

spec.title: Executor Workload Skewness (Read)
spec.description: Visualizes work imbalance by comparing the mean load with the extra load handled by the most strained executor.

spec.title: Active Executors
spec.description: Mean number of compute nodes participating in the job execution.

spec.title: Stage Breakdown: Latency Analysis
spec.description: Heatmap-style matrix showing the duration of individual Spark stages across different backends.

spec.title: Execution Stages
spec.description: Average number of logical stages generated by the Spark optimizer for the specific query.

spec.title: Spark Execution Time Distribution
spec.description: Box plot analysis of Spark execution times across RDD, DataFrame, and SQL approaches. It displays the statistical distribution (Min, Q1, Median, Q3, Max) of computing times, where the gap visually isolates driver overhead and red markers pinpoint performance anomalies.

spec.title: Sky Analytics Engine — Performance & Infrastructure Metrics
